summary: Full **Membres** directory & access management: CRUD `/api/v1/users`, strict audience mapping (`public` / `staff` / `board`), soft-delete (`status = deleted` + auto-disable account + remove holders), `admin`-only account & Google unlink endpoints, RGPD `anonymize` (preserving historical `documents` & `attendance`), `/api/v1/public/members`, and web table + 6-tab member detail UI with WhatsApp invite shortcut. **Server + web (wasmJs) + Astro public API**.
overview:
Fase 2 core member management slice governing colla people, guardians, RGPD consents, app accounts, and the public member directory for Astro.

**Source of truth:** `docs/especificacion-tecnica.md` v1.3 §4.1–4.4, §5.4, §6.7 (personas), §6.8 (`/public/members`), §7.4 (Membres), §10.1–10.2 · `docs/decisiones.md`.

**Prerequisites**
- `platform-schema-v02` (`users`, `user_accounts`, `user_guardians`, `google_identities`, `sessions`, `org_role_holders`).
- `platform-core-contract` (`UserBoard`, `UserStaff`, `UserPublic`, `MemberStatus.DELETED`, `PatchField`).
- `platform-server-auth` (`SessionService` cache invalidation when disabling/deleting accounts).
- `platform-files` (for `PUT/DELETE /api/v1/users/{id}/avatar`), `platform-web-shell`, `platform-openapi-deploy`.

**Key RGPD & lifecycle rules (`decisiones.md` & §5.4)**
- **Audience mapping on `/api/v1/users` and `/api/v1/users/{id}`:**
  - `anonymous`: `401` on private; `/api/v1/public/members` returns only `status = active && consent.publicProfile == true && !isMinor` with `{id, name, lastNames, nickname, aboutMe, avatar, orgRoles}` and `Cache-Control: public, max-age=300`.
  - `member`: `403` on `GET /users`; `404` on `GET /users/{id}` for any other user (§10.1.2; own data is accessed via `/me`).
  - `technical`: `200` on `GET /users` and `GET /users/{id}` mapped strictly to **`UserStaff`** (fields of level `public`, `members`, `staff`: includes `status`, `membershipType`, `joinedAt`, `heightCm`, `isMinor`, `emergencyContact`, `orgRoles`, `positions`; **excludes** `board`/`self` fields such as `birthDate`, `documentId`, `email`, `phoneNumber`, `address`, `memberNumber`, `leftAt`, `sizes`, `guardians`, `consent`, `account`, `notes`). `403` on all writes.
  - `board`: full `UserBoard` read + CRUD (`POST`/`PATCH`/`DELETE /users*`, avatar upload); `403` on `/users/{id}/account*`, `/anonymize`, and `?hard=true`.
  - `admin`: full `UserBoard` + account management + `anonymize` + `?hard=true`.
- **Minors:** `isMinor` is computed dynamically against today's date in `Europe/Madrid` (false if `birthDate == null`). When `isMinor == true`, `guardians` must contain ≥ 1 guardian (`422 validation_failed`). Minors NEVER appear in `/api/v1/public/members` even if `consent.publicProfile == true`.
- **Soft delete (`DELETE /api/v1/users/{id}`, `decisiones.md`):** sets `users.status = 'deleted'`, removes the user from `org_role_holders`, and **automatically disables their account** (`user_accounts.status = 'disabled'` + revokes all their active `sessions` + invalidates session cache). Personal data, `documents`, and `attendance` remain intact in case the person returns. Cannot soft-delete the last active `admin` (`409` / `422`). `?hard=true` (`admin` only) physically deletes the user unless blocked by `documents` `ON DELETE RESTRICT` (`409 in_use`) or last-admin guard.
- **Anonymize (`POST /api/v1/users/{id}/anonymize`, `admin` only, `decisiones.md`):** requires `{"confirm": true}` (`422` otherwise) and rejects if target is the last active `admin`. In one transaction: wipes identifiable PII (`name = "Persona eliminada"`, clears `lastNames`, `nickname`, `birthDate`, `documentId`, `email`, `phoneNumber`, `address_*`, `aboutMe`, `avatar_file_id`, `member_number`, `emergency_contact_*`, `notes`, resets `consent_* = 0`), sets `status = 'deleted'`, deletes `user_guardians`, `user_accounts`, `google_identities`, `sessions` (+ cache invalidation), removes from `org_role_holders`, sets `positions.user_id = NULL`, and deletes avatar blobs post-commit — while **keeping the `users` row, its `documents`, and its `attendance` records** for historical integrity.
- **Last-admin protection:** `PATCH /users/{id}/account`, `DELETE /users/{id}/account`, `DELETE /users/{id}`, and `anonymize` must prevent removing/disabling the last active `admin` account (`409` / `422`).

**Acceptance (slice)**
- `./gradlew :server:test :app:shared:jvmTest :app:webApp:compileKotlinWasmJs` passes.
- Permission & RGPD matrix verifies: `member` gets `404` on another user's `GET /users/{id}`; `technical` gets `200` with `UserStaff` (zero `board`/`self` fields like `birthDate`, `documentId`, `notes`, `guardians`, `email`); `board` gets `UserBoard` and `403` on account/anonymize routes; `admin` manages accounts with last-admin guard; `/public/members` never exposes minors or non-public users.
- `DELETE /users/{id}` sets `status = deleted`, strips `org_role_holders`, disables account, and revokes active sessions.
- `anonymize` wipes PII + account + guardians + avatar + holders while keeping `users` row, `documents`, and `attendance`.
- Web UI at `/membres` renders summary banner (actius, amb compte, menors, perfil públic), searchable/filterable table, 6-tab member detail (`Dades personals`, `Colla`, `Contacte i emergència`, `Tutors`, `Consentiments`, `Accés` for admin), role-aware read-only/hidden fields, and «Avisa per WhatsApp» invite button.
- `OpenApiRouteSyncTest` passes.
shared_ui_policy: All members UI, ViewModels, and repositories live in `:app:shared` `commonMain`. `:app:webApp` hosts wasm only. Android/desktop/JS out of v1 scope.
out_of_scope:
- Self profile `/me` and `/me/export` (`platform-server-auth` + `platform-me-rgpd`).
- Organigrama CRUD (`spec-01-org-chart`).
- Bulk CSV/PII import scripts.
- Medical notes special-category RGPD fields (§12.4 open question).
- Android, desktop, JS, iOS clients.

auth.client: Bearer JWT via `SessionManager`. Tab `/membres` visible when `users:read` is present (`technical`, `board`, `admin`). Edit controls require `users:write`; Accés tab & anonymize require `accounts:admin`.
auth.server: `technical` read (`UserStaff`); `board` full CRUD (`UserBoard`); `admin` adds account endpoints, `anonymize`, and `?hard=true`; `member` receives `404` on other users' `GET /users/{id}` and `403` on `GET /users`.

components.name: Users.sq
components.usage: SQLDelight queries for filtered/paginated users (`status`, `membershipType`, `isMinor` via Madrid cutoff date, `orgRoleId`, `areaId`, `hasAccount`, `q`), guardians CRUD, account admin queries, count active admins, soft-delete, anonymize, and public members.

components.name: UserService + AccountAdminService
components.usage: Transactional user CRUD (with minor guardian validation, default `groupId = ownGroup`, `memberNumber` uniqueness `409 duplicate`), soft-delete (`deleted` + strip holders + disable account + revoke sessions), `anonymize` (preserving `documents` & `attendance`), avatar upload/delete via `FileStorageService`, and `admin` account invite/patch/unlink-Google/delete with last-admin guard.
components.notes: Calls `SessionService.invalidateUserCache(userId)` whenever account status/role changes or sessions are revoked.

components.name: UserMapper
components.usage: Strict DTO mappers for `UserPublic`, `UserStaff`, and `UserBoard` (reusing `UserSelfMapper` where helpful).

components.name: UserRoutes
components.usage: Mounts all 13 private + public user and account endpoints.

components.name: MuixerangaApi (users extension)
components.usage: Client methods for users CRUD, avatar upload/delete, account invite/patch/unlink/delete, and anonymize.

components.name: MembersRepository + MembersViewModel
components.usage: Manages member list, summary metrics, filters/search, detail tabs, role-aware edit/read-only state, account admin actions, WhatsApp invite URI builder, anonymize confirmation, and `409` conflict handling.

components.name: MembersScreen + MemberEditDrawer + NewMemberModal
components.usage: Routes `/membres` and `/membres/{id}` matching mockups: `SectionHeader` + `+ NOVA PERSONA`, 4 clickable KPI filter cards (`Membres actius`, `Amb accés a l'app`, `Menors`, `Amb perfil públic`), search (`Busca per nom, malnom o correu`) + `Tots els accessos` + `Tots els càrrecs` dropdowns, table (`PERSONA` with colored initials or Bearer avatar, nickname, `Públic`/`Menor` badges; `CÀRRECS` chip; `ESTAT` pill; `ACCÉS` role / `Sense accés`; chevron), right-side `Edita el membre` drawer (grouped white cards/tabs for `Dades personals` incl. `preferredLocale`, `Colla`, `Contacte i emergència`, `Tutors`, `Consentiments`, and `admin`-only `Accés` with «Avisa per WhatsApp» + anonymize, sticky `Cancel·la` / `DESA`), and centered `Nova persona` modal using real member fields.

structure:
Vertical slice flow:

```text
Web /membres & /membres/{id}
  → MembersViewModel → MembersRepository → MuixerangaApi
  ↕ JSON + Multipart (Bearer)
Server UserRoutes → UserService / AccountAdminService (+ SessionService, FileStorageService) → UserMapper → Users.sq
  ↑
Astro public site → GET /api/v1/public/members (Cache-Control: public, max-age=300)
```

sections.title: Filters and `isMinor` SQL calculation
sections.description: `GET /api/v1/users` supports `page`, `perPage`, `status` (defaults to excluding `deleted` unless explicitly filtered), `membershipType`, `isMinor` (bool), `orgRoleId`, `areaId`, `hasAccount` (bool), `q` (search in `name`, `last_names`, `nickname`), and `sort` (`name`, `memberNumber`, `joinedAt`, `createdAt`; default `name`).
sections.behavior: Compute the 18-year cutoff `LocalDate` in `Europe/Madrid` (`today.minusYears(18)`): a user is minor iff `birth_date IS NOT NULL AND birth_date > :cutoffIsoDate`.

sections.title: Admin account lifecycle & WhatsApp invite (§4.1 & §7.4)
sections.description: `POST /users/{id}/account` creates an `invited` account (`loginEmail` lowercased, unique → `409 duplicate`). `DELETE /users/{id}/account/google` deletes `google_identities`, revokes all sessions, and resets status to `invited`. `PATCH /users/{id}/account` updates `role`, `status`, or `loginEmail` (disabling revokes all sessions immediately).
sections.behavior: After inviting a member in the `Accés` tab, display a «Avisa per WhatsApp» action opening `https://wa.me/<e164WithoutPlus>?text=<urlEncoded>` with «Ja pots entrar a https://admin.muixerangadelx.com amb el teu compte de Google (<loginEmail>).»

sections.title: Soft-delete vs Anonymize (`decisiones.md`)
sections.description: `DELETE /users/{id}` is a reversible member deactivation (`status = deleted`, holders cleared, account disabled, sessions revoked, data kept). `POST /users/{id}/anonymize` is an irreversible RGPD erasure (`confirm: true`) that strips PII, guardians, account, Google link, sessions, holders, positions (`user_id = NULL`), and avatar files while retaining the `users` row (`name = "Persona eliminada"`, `status = deleted`), `documents`, and `attendance`.
sections.behavior: In the UI, `anonymize` is accessible only to `admin` behind an explicit double-confirmation dialog warning that the operation is irreversible.

endpoints.name: Soft-delete or hard-delete user
endpoints.notes: `board`/`admin`: sets `status = deleted`, strips holders, disables account + revokes sessions (`204`). `?hard=true`: `admin` only (`409 in_use` if documents linked).

endpoints.name: Upload user avatar
endpoints.notes: `board`/`admin`. Multipart `file` (JPEG/PNG/WebP, max 5 MB). Upload rate limit.

endpoints.name: Update user account
endpoints.notes: `admin` only. Update `role`, `status`, `loginEmail`; last-admin guard; revokes sessions when disabled.

endpoints.name: Unlink Google identity
endpoints.notes: `admin` only. Deletes `google_identities`, revokes sessions, resets `status = invited` (`204`).

endpoints.name: Delete user account
endpoints.notes: `admin` only. Removes account, Google link, and sessions; keeps `User`. Last-admin guard.

endpoints.name: Anonymize user (RGPD erasure)
endpoints.notes: `admin` only. Requires `{"confirm": true}`. Wipes PII/account/guardians/avatar/holders/positions; sets `status = deleted`; retains row + `documents` + `attendance`.

endpoints.name: Public members directory
endpoints.notes: Anonymous, `Cache-Control: public, max-age=300`. Only `status = active`, `consent.publicProfile = true`, `!isMinor`.

persistence: Uses SQLite v0.2 `users`, `user_accounts`, `user_guardians`, `google_identities`, `sessions`, `org_role_holders`, `positions`, `stored_files`, `documents`, `attendance` via `Users.sq`. No new migrations.
